# Zander Martineau

> Personal site of Zander Martineau, a front-end developer in London, UK. Blog posts, worklog, code notes, projects, CV and more.

## Main pages
- [About](https://zander.wtf/about): who I am
- [Blog](https://zander.wtf/blog): posts and worklog entries
- [Code notes](https://zander.wtf/notes): short technical notes
- [Projects](https://zander.wtf/projects): side projects and packages
- [CV](https://zander.wtf/cv): work history
- [Now](https://zander.wtf/now): what I am doing now
- [Uses](https://zander.wtf/uses): my setup
